This looks good. You probably have this, but just to remind. Be sure to get copies of closed initiatives from Kris. We need to review as a team so we know which ones we are depending on to be solid when we execute the 18 month plan. Jaren is helping me with a closure review process we can use to determine whether these closed actions are solid. I have a feeling most of them won't be. So when the time feels natural, make sure Phii knows we will need to review closed actions for quality as a part of this effort.

To be honest, I am thinking we probably need to do a class on how to properly close actions to action owners know what is expected. I would be interested in knowing what you think about that
